title: Strong driving performance
summary: Feedback in this topic mainly describes the G70's driving and overall performance positively, while many other fragments mention performance too briefly to convey a clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise overall and driving performance as good, great, amazing, strong, or excellent.

negative.summary: The only negative-coded example provided actually describes complete driving performance and sufficient ride comfort, so the negative aspect is unclear from the available evidence.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention performance in fragmentary terms without enough context to tell whether the customer view is favorable or unfavorable.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are very short mentions of performance, which limits detail about specific strengths or weaknesses.
The sole negative-coded example appears textually positive, so the negative concern cannot be reliably characterized from the supplied examples.
This is a sentiment-stratified sample of fragments rather than a representative sample of all reviews.
